_comment: C0-14 vidu bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（kling/hailuo-video/flux），related 写 3 条。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。filing_note_en 引文里的算法备案中文名「Vidu视频生成算法-1/-2」属官方登记名合法 B 类残留。

axes.model_access: In-house Vidu video large-model line (official FAQ: released by Beijing Shengshu Technology jointly with Tsinghua University, leading on long duration/high consistency/high dynamics); users do not pick bare models. An open-weights line — no official statement verified.
axes.runtime: Web (vidu.cn domestic entry / vidu.com overseas entry) + API (the enterprise side, official narrative); generation on the vendor's cloud.
axes.local_files: Works stored account-side in the cloud, generation history visible on the web works page; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video, image-to-video, **reference-to-video (multi-subject reference)** is the differentiating function named by the official side (character-consistency oriented); a first/last-frame control line (seen in the official FAQ); a 2D-animation style line (official FAQ narrative).
axes.context: Organized by account works; cross-session memory — no official statement verified. Multi-subject reference is its "consistency" mechanism — reusable reference images are not memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line. Filing: the Vidu filing no. Beijing-Vidu-20241125S0003 (CAC 2025-01 published batch, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-22); the algorithm filings "Vidu视频生成算法-1/-2" appear in the deep-synthesis algorithm filing list (cross-checked on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's disclosure page).
axes.fit: Fits: narrative/animation-oriented generation with high character-consistency demands (multi-subject reference), domestic direct connection, anime-style motion. Does not fit: model self-selection, open weights, a photorealistic cinematic set-piece focus.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Consistency falloff of multi-subject reference in 3+ character scenes**
- **The actual interpolation quality of first/last-frame control**
- **Work interoperability between the domestic/overseas dual entries**
unknowns:
- The open-weights line (no official statement verified)
- The API enterprise side's access surface and quotas (not verified item by item)
- The training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both domestic video leaders: Kling's ecosystem surface is wide, Vidu's differentiator is multi-subject reference consistency.
Both domestic in-house video entries: Hailuo's entry is light, Vidu's feature surface (reference/first-last frame) is finer.
Upstream/downstream handoff: Vidu's image-to-video often takes FLUX-family images as the first frame.
